reviews.text:
Thank you so much for kindly accepting our elderly miniature dachshund! The staff were all incredibly kind, and we felt completely at ease leaving her in your care. I can't believe such a wonderful place exists so close by! 👍 I'd love to come back again, even just for a shampoo!

The photo shoot was also a first-time experience for her! 😆 It will be a wonderful memory! 🤲

My dog ​​is a valued customer here, and we've been going there every month for about three years now because we have a great rapport with the staff member in charge. I feel completely at ease entrusting my dog's grooming to them.
They also offer pet-sitting services, which is very helpful, and the staff are very friendly.

The first time I used their services, the staff didn't offer much of a greeting or thank you, which made me wonder why the reviews were so good. However, the second time, a different staff member greeted me cheerfully, which was a relief.

The dogs staying at the pet hotel roam freely and bark in the treatment room, so dogs that are afraid of other dogs might be scared.

They had a variety of shampoo options. I chose this place because they also offer raking. The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. After the shampoo, they sent me a photo taken to match the season via LINE. Thank you!
